paragraphs: The brother of Rabbi Horyna and Rabbi Shmuel bar Sosartai. He is mentioned in the Jerusalem Talmud, Bava Batra, chapter 9, halakhah 3.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 9:3 paragraph explicitly names Rabbi Horyna as brother of Rabbi Shmuel bar Sosartai and gives Alexandri as his brother addressing him. Hyman’s Alexander form and family direction remain, without a new genealogy binding or importing their financial dispute.
